_comment: Named pose/person-detector combinations (D-023). Every end2end.onnx is pinned by sha256 and size in bytes, measured on disk 2026-09-25 with sha256sum and stat, and repeated in configs/models.sha256. backend selects the pose path in detector/factory.py; det_* are null for the bottom-up rtmo backend. The variant named in default.json model.variant must match its entry here (tests/test_configs.py). Input sizes: rtmpose-m 192x256 and yolox-tiny 416x416 from D-008; yolox-m 640x640 from the D-016 sweep (bench/sweep_detector.py VARIANTS at commit f28ee84); rtmpose-x/-l 288x384 and rtmw-dw-l-m 192x256 from each zip's pipeline.json (M3, D-028).

rtmpose-m.source: D-008 pinned default: RTMPose-m body7 256x192 + YOLOX-tiny humanart

rtmpose-m_yolox-m.source: D-016 alternative person detector: RTMPose-m body7 + YOLOX-m humanart

rtmpose-x.source: M3 pose sweep (D-028), downloaded 2026-09-25 from download.openmmlab.com/mmpose/v1/projects/rtmposev1/onnx_sdk/rtmpose-x_simcc-body7_pt-body7_700e-384x288-71d7b7e9_20230629.zip (zip sha256 1174dd5c..., 184294200 bytes); input 288x384 (w,h) from the zip pipeline.json; + YOLOX-tiny (D-008)

rtmpose-x_yolox-m.source: M3 pose sweep (D-028), downloaded 2026-09-25 from download.openmmlab.com/mmpose/v1/projects/rtmposev1/onnx_sdk/rtmpose-x_simcc-body7_pt-body7_700e-384x288-71d7b7e9_20230629.zip (zip sha256 1174dd5c..., 184294200 bytes); + YOLOX-m (D-016 alternative) to test box sensitivity of the 384x288 crop

rtmpose-l.source: M3 pose sweep (D-028), downloaded 2026-09-25 from download.openmmlab.com/mmpose/v1/projects/rtmposev1/onnx_sdk/rtmpose-l_simcc-body7_pt-body7_420e-384x288-3f5a1437_20230504.zip (zip sha256 fed40dcf..., 103712404 bytes; URL absent from rtmlib 0.0.16, verified HTTP 200 on the mmpose zoo); input 288x384 from pipeline.json; + YOLOX-tiny

rtmw-dw-l-m.source: M3 pose sweep (D-028), downloaded 2026-09-25 from download.openmmlab.com/mmpose/v1/projects/rtmw/onnx_sdk/rtmw-dw-l-m_simcc-cocktail14_270e-256x192_20231122.zip (zip sha256 a6d08a57..., 120002068 bytes; flat zip, extracted by hand under 20231122/rtmw_onnx/<stem>/); 133 COCO-WholeBody keypoints sliced to the body 17 (factory rtmw backend); input 192x256 from pipeline.json; + YOLOX-tiny

rtmpose-l_yolox-m.source: M3 pose sweep (D-028), downloaded 2026-09-25 from download.openmmlab.com/mmpose/v1/projects/rtmposev1/onnx_sdk/rtmpose-l_simcc-body7_pt-body7_420e-384x288-3f5a1437_20230504.zip (zip sha256 fed40dcf..., 103712404 bytes; URL absent from rtmlib 0.0.16, verified HTTP 200 on the mmpose zoo); input 288x384 from pipeline.json; + YOLOX-m (D-016 alternative), added for parity with rtmpose-x_yolox-m after the first sweep showed the S-type gates and the 2D step are box-sensitive (D-028)
